newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan export agent details wheat purchase.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan export agent details wheat purchase.

text.p: Pakistan over the weekend bought a total of 270,000 tonnes of U.S. and Australian wheat, said its U.S. export agent, Universal Shipping Co.

The deal included 180,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat out of which 30,000 tonnes wheat was from Continental Grain in a range of $152.97-$153.69 a tonne, 60,000 tonnes from Cargill Inc in 20,000-tonne lots each at $153.29, $153.74 and $153.94.

Another 45,000 tonnes was from United Grain Corp, comprised of two 20,000-tonne lots at $153.32 and $153.69 and 5,000 tonnes at $154.43. The agent also said 20,000 tonnes was from Harvest States in two 10,000-tonne lots at $153.40 and $153.99.
Pakistan also bought 25,000 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus Corp at $153.80.
The U.S. wheat was slated for January 8-31 delivery.
From Australia, 90,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat was purchased from Citic Australia Food at US$160.365 a tonne for January 25-31 delivery.
